delete.title: Delete column
delete.intro: "{title}" will no longer be public, and it cannot be restored here. Unused column codes will be revoked. Existing subscription records stay.
delete.articleHintUnknown: Articles in this column follow the choice below.
delete.keepPaidHint: Articles stay. Readers can no longer open them with a column subscription and need an individual unlock. Unpriced articles stay unpriced.
delete.deleteArticlesHint: These articles disappear from the site. Their text stays in the database and is not physically removed.

articles.title: Articles
articles.empty: No articles in this column yet
articles.confirmPaid: This paid article will no longer be unlocked individually. Unused article codes will stop working.
articles.confirmMove: This article will leave "{title}" and be read through this column.
articles.confirmRemove: "{title}" will become free. Column subscribers will no longer read it with this subscription.

records.title: Subscriptions and codes
records.readonly: This page is read-only. Authors create codes and edit their own columns.
